steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Ooohhh... give it to me... give it to me...
She swings the water pipe and sends flying an approaching Corruptor.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Move! Move! This damn elevator has to be stuck in this awkward position. There's no way of getting out!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content:
If we don't do something, we'll be eaten alive sooner or later!
—Ah!
The elevator jerks and starts dropping. It travels a distance before coming to a shaky stop.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's something above. On the cable...
The top of the elevator is already gone. Hanging on the far end of the cable are several contorted shades, sawing away at the cable with their Mania machetes.
For a fleeting moment, you see in those soulless eyes naked murderous malice, something you've never seen before in other Corruptors.
After a flash of light from the steel, the thick and taut cable is severed. The elevator floor dips, and the elevator starts falling at a surprising speed.
